explanation: The name often used for God in the Old Testament, the almighty Creator.
To express admiration or gratitude for something, especially toward God for His deeds and character.
A person dedicated to serving or carrying out tasks for another, here referring to believers who serve God.
The time when the sun rises above the horizon in the morning, symbolizing the beginning of a new day.
The time when the sun sinks below the horizon in the evening, marking the end of the day.
A designation that identifies and represents a person; here it refers to God's name and character.
An adjective describing something far above the ground or above a certain level, used here to describe God's position and greatness.
An adjective describing something near the ground or below a certain level, used here to describe human position compared with God.
A woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried, often seen as a vulnerable group in society.
A person who has lost their father or does not have a father to take responsibility for them, also regarded as a vulnerable group.
